top_signal.title: Canada-based, with suppliers in India who'll work with me as partners. What products would you start with on a small budget?
top_signal.summary: I'm in Canada and I have good supplier contacts in India. They'd rather build something with me than just ship me a pallet, so the setup is closer to a partnership than a standard buy-and-resell deal. I'll sort out the structure separately. Right now I want to get the product right.   I can source almost anything except industrial and engineering goods, which need more capital than I want to put in upfront. Everything else is on the table.   What I'm looking for is a product that:     Costs little to test, with small first orders   Has a real price or quality edge from India   Won't get eaten by duties, shipping, or returns on the way into Canada     I'd like to hear from anyone who's imported from India or run a similar setup. What sold? What sat in storage? What looked great on paper and fell apart once customs and shipping were counted?   Categories I'm curious about: textiles and home goods, spices and food, handicrafts, wellness and personal care, apparel. Tell me if I'm missing an obvious one or if one of these is a trap.   Real numbers and war stories welcome, including the ugly ones.       submitted by     /u/TheListeningSoul       [link]       [comments]
